grades.quote: The divide and remainder instructions are equivalent to the RISC-V standard scalar integer multiply/divides, with the same results for extreme inputs.
grades.reason: RISC-V vector divide section only says results match scalar divide for extreme inputs. It never states the divide-by-zero result or exception behavior, so it is auxiliary at best.
Covers floating-point/integer conversion, not integer division by zero.
Covers the LoongArch floating-point invalid operation exception, not integer division by zero.

grades.quote: The value of all bits set is returned for both unsigned and signed divide by zero to simplify the divider circuitry.
grades.reason: RISC-V M extension rationale says integer divide by zero returns all bits set for signed and unsigned. That gives the result and implies no trap. It does not explicitly mention exceptions or the remainder.
